results.title: US Appeals Court Blocks Trump’s $400 Million White House Ballroom Project Pending Congressional Approval
results.description: A US federal appeals court has blocked above-ground construction of Donald Trump’s proposed $400 million White House ballroom, ruling that major changes to the White House require congressional approval. The decision keeps underground work moving for now and gives the administration 14 days to seek relief from the US Supreme Court.
